summary_md: **Jason | growth data for AI agents ([@jasongrowthdata](https://x.com/jasongrowthdata/status/2115428369856888851))** pulled the skills.sh security audits for 1,723 agent skills: 86% passed every scanner, 13% got a warning, 6 failed, and automation skills were flagged about 3x as often as writing skills. His advice is to read the audit and the flagged part of SKILL.md before installing.
relevance: Ecosystem-level data on agent-skill risk by category.
